name: 99507 · Anchorage, AK
findings: ZIP 99507 (Anchorage) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99507 (Anchorage) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
